nodePlan.targetLane: Give one more untimed, partial-visibility retrieval rep on "building" since it slipped to "bilding" under the timed hidden-word checkpoint, without re-teaching a word she has already spelled correctly three separate times.
nodePlan.title: Building Retrieval Practice

nodePlan.targetLane: Fresh, independent recall check across all 20 words to confirm "building" holds again after the extra practice rep, and that gnat, special, and the other 17 words remain correct with no fatigue cost.
nodePlan.title: Spelling Checkpoint

planTheory.hypothesis: Demo-pashley's silent-letter/soft-sound chunking strategy, reinforced with a second teach-plus-untimed-practice cycle, now generalizes to the gn- pattern (gnat) and the ci→/sh pattern (special): both are spelled correctly, unaided, on an independent fresh checkpoint after reverting once before. The wr-, kn-, -mb, and ci→/s patterns, plus the 11 originally-known words, continue to hold steady with no fatigue cost. However, 'building' — previously fixed and confirmed correct three times — reverted once to 'bilding' on the newest, stricter timed (8s) hidden-word, whole-word-input checkpoint, which provided no per-item response time to evaluate whether this was a genuine lapse or a speed/format-pressure artifact (consistent with an earlier timed-mechanic slip on a different word). The theory is revised to withhold judgment on 'building' specifically until one more untimed retrieval rep and one more fresh, independent checkpoint are observed, rather than either re-teaching it from scratch or declaring the full word set consolidated.
